## base_drift (`content/rules/base_drift.json`)

Trait drift (GARDEN.md section 3, lever 3; scripts/home/base_drift.gd): with farm_build.json base_mode on, once per in-game day at home each Boki's four traits (0..1) move a small step toward the average of its friends (base life bonds at or above base_life friend_at). Rivals do not pull.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| step | 0.03 |
| step_doc | share of the gap between a Boki's trait and its friends' average that closes each in-game day. |
| week_days | 7 |
| week_days_doc | in-game days in a drift week; the cap below resets when a Boki's week ends. |
| week_cap | 0.12 |
| week_cap_doc | most a single trait may move (either way, summed) in one drift week, in trait units (0..1). |
| bands | [0.33, 0.67] |
| bands_doc | trait values at which a trait changes band (low, middle, high); crossing one writes a journal line. |
| words | {"bravery": ["braver", "shyer"], "loyalty": ["more loyal", "more independent"], "temper": ["hotter-tempered", "calmer"], "curiosity": ["more curious", "more settled"]} |
| words_doc | per trait: [line when it rises, line when it falls], written as 'is getting <word>' in the Boki's journal. |

## base_echo (`content/rules/base_echo.json`)

Echo Steps, a call-and-answer dance on four humming stones (briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md section 4.2, game 2; scripts/home/echo_steps.gd). Only with farm_build.json base_mode on. The lead hops a pattern across the stones on the beat and you answer it with W, A, S, D; in the last round you lead and the rival copies. Hits and streaks score. Solo (the stones lead) with one rested Boki out, against the next rested Boki with two. Units: beats at bpm, milliseconds for the hit window, seconds otherwise; joy and trust are 0-100 points.

Only with farm_build.json base_mode on. 2 to 4 Boki run one lap of a short loop next to the Training post; you back your partner and cheer with the training drill's timing bar at three marks. Each runs one leg and hands the baton on at a mark; your two hand-offs are the Dash's cheer press on the timing bar. Prizes and the cup: garden_prizes.json 'relay'. Units: seconds; joy is 0-100 points, bonds -1..1.

## base_tumble (`content/rules/base_tumble.json`)

Tumble, a duel beside the Stump Shove's stump (briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md 4.2 game 1, scripts/home/base_tumble.gd). Only with farm_build.json base_mode on. Best of five exchanges; both sides pick Rush, Brace or Dodge at once; the winner pushes the loser back along a ring three steps deep on each side. Units: seconds, steps (the ring's unit of push), metres, stat points (0-100), trust 0-100.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| moves | {"rush": {"stat": "power", "beats": "dodge", "trait": "temper", "name": "Rush", "clip": "rush"}, "brace": {"stat": "guard", "beats": "rush", "trait": "loyalty", "name": "Brace", "clip": "brace"}, "dodge": {"stat": "speed", "beats": "brace", "trait": "curiosity", "name": "Dodge", "clip": "dodge"}} |
| moves_doc | Keys 1, 2, 3 in this order. Each move pushes with its stat and beats one other; 'trait' is the personality that leans a Boki toward it, 'clip' its rig clip (BokiHomeClips, as long as impact_s; Brace adds the 'guard' pose for bodies without a rig). |
| exchanges | 5 |
| extra_max | 2 |
| exchanges_doc | A bout is five exchanges; a dead level after five plays up to extra_max more, then goes to whoever won more exchanges (the rival on a full tie). |
| depth | 3 |
| depth_doc | Steps from the middle to each edge of the ring: pushed this far back is out. |
| lead | 20 |
| lead_doc | A win pushes one step, two when the winner's push for its move's stat is this much over the loser's for the same stat. |
| clash_step | 0.5 |
| clash_doc | The same move on both sides: the higher push for that stat moves the other half a step (nothing on a dead level). |
| base | 10 |
| base_doc | Points of push every Boki has before its stat, so the edge, press and follow multipliers count with zero trained points. |
| edge | 1.1 |
| edge_doc | Push multiplier when a species theme beats the other's in base_shove.json 'beats' (the Shove's 10% type edge). |
| follow | 1.1 |
| follow_trust | 1 |
| follow_doc | Going with what your own Boki wants: push multiplier for that exchange and trust (points, paid when the bout is settled). Overriding it costs nothing. |
| press | {"great": 1.15, "good": 1.07, "miss": 1.0} |
| press_doc | The timed press on impact (the drill bar): push multiplier for that exchange. |
| rival_press | {"great": 0.2, "good": 0.45} |
| rival_press_doc | The rival's own impact press: chance of a great, else of a good, else a miss. |
| lean_centre | {"temper": 0.36, "loyalty": 0.72, "curiosity": 0.55} |
| lean_floor | 0.34 |
| lean_min | 0.05 |
| lean_doc | How likely a Boki is to want each move: lean_floor plus its trait minus that trait's centre, never under lean_min. The centres are set so each move is wanted a third of the time across the common species of content/kin_v2, birth noise included. |
| honest | [0.7, 0.5] |
| honest_doc | Chance the tell you see is the move the other side really plans: for the side with the higher Focus, and for the other (and on equal Focus). |
| rival_read | 0.35 |
| rival_read_doc | Chance the rival plays against what your Boki wants (as its own tell shows it) instead of its nature. |
| intro_s | 6 |
| tell_s | 1.5 |
| pick_s | 3 |
| impact_s | 2.5 |
| push_s | 6.8 |
| result_s | 5.5 |
| time_doc | Seconds: the walk to the marks before the first tell; the rival's tell; the pick window after it (no pick goes with what your Boki wants); the charge, with one press on the drill bar while it runs (none is a miss), the hit landing as it ends; the shove, slide, shake-off and walk back to the marks with the push shown; the tumble off before the card. |
| visitor_spread | 15 |
| visitor_doc | With one rested Boki, a garden visitor is the rival: a random species, each stat within this many points of yours. |
| ring_off | [-2.4, 0.0, -2.6] |
| ring_doc | Metres from the stump to the ring's middle (clear of the stump's reach). |
| reach_m | 1.6 |
| step_m | 0.35 |
| gap_m | 0.6 |
| charge_m | 0.3 |
| slide_rate | 4 |
| geometry_doc | Metres from the ring's middle to start a bout; a step moves the pair step_m; each Boki stands gap_m from the contact point, charge_m closer while it charges in; the shown push catches up with the real one at slide_rate a second. |
| energy | 8 |
| energy_doc | Energy each Boki spends on a bout (who may play is the Dash's min_energy, base_race.json). |
| win_joy | 12 |
| win_trust | 3 |
| lose_joy | -8 |
| gems_win | 4 |
| gems_ran | 1 |
| gems_doc | Gems to you when your Boki wins, or for any other bout (as the Stump Shove). |
| card_s | 6 |

## base_volley (`content/rules/base_volley.json`)

Spark Volley, the Boki base's fourth minigame (briefs/design/GARDEN.md section 5.4, scripts/home/base_volley.gd). Only with farm_build.json base_mode on. Two Boki bat a glowing seed over a log, first to to_win points; a miss gives the other side the point. You back your partner and call one spike on the training drill's bar. Units: seconds, joy and trust are 0-100 points.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| to_win | 5 |
| base_return | 0.7 |
| base_doc | Chance a Boki returns a seed hit by an equal Boki. The real chance is base_return times its own strength over the hitter's, kept between min_return and max_return. |
| min_return | 0.25 |
| max_return | 0.92 |
| speed_per_point | 0.005 |
| focus_per_point | 0.005 |
| stats_doc | Strength = (1 + Speed points x speed_per_point) x (1 + Focus points x focus_per_point): Speed gets it under the seed, Focus reads where it goes. Half a percent a point each, like the match bonus. |
| mood | [0.92, 1.08] |
| mood_doc | Strength multiplier at joy 0 and at joy 100 (linear in between). |
| trust_max | 1.05 |
| trust_doc | Strength multiplier at trust 100 (linear from 1.0 at trust 0). |
| edge | 1.08 |
| edge_doc | Strength multiplier for a Boki whose species theme beats the other's (the 'beats' table of content/rules/base_shove.json, so there is one element table). |
| spike | {"great": 0.3, "good": 0.6, "miss": 1.0} |
| spike_doc | Your one call: the backed Boki's next hit is a spike and the other side's chance to return it is multiplied by this. |
| serve_s | 0.8 |
| fly_s | 0.75 |
| spike_fly_s | 0.4 |
| point_s | 1.1 |
| max_s | 150 |
| max_doc | A match still going at this many seconds goes to the side ahead (the server on a tie). |
| energy | 8 |
| energy_doc | Each player spends this much energy (BaseRace.entrants only picks rested Boki). |
| win_joy | 12 |
| win_trust | 3 |
| lose_joy | -8 |
| gems_win | 4 |
| gems_ran | 1 |
| gems_doc | Gems to you when your backed Boki wins, or for any other match. |
| card_s | 6 |
| courts | {"glasswater": {"at": [38.5, 31.5], "splash": "9fe4f2"}} |
| courts_doc | A zone's own court (GardenZones.here): at = the log's middle, tiles; splash = the colour of the water a miss throws up. It lies across the zone's shallow channel (garden_zones.json build.shallow) and needs no Training post. |

## How kit hits land on a Boki (`content/rules/boki_hit.json`)

How Hunter kits hit a Boki (BokiHit, docs/decisions/0047). Source parity: the source's creeps and summons take every ability as written (one number per card, no creep scaling) and every crowd control on the cards works on them.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| dmg_k | {"summoned": 1.0, "wild": 1.0} |
| cc | ["stun", "root", "slow", "burn", "blight"] |
| execute | True |

## boki_lines (`content/rules/boki_lines.json`)

What Boki say (BokiLines, docs/BOKI_TALK.md). tuning: max_words = the most words in one bubble (punctuation and symbols don't count); act_words = the most words in one action, which a young Boki says after its name; bubble_s = seconds a bubble stays up; cooldown_s = seconds a Boki waits between lines (a trigger marked direct answers something you did and skips the wait); no_repeat = how many of its own last lines a Boki never repeats; min_lines = the fewest general lines a trigger may have; grown_stage = the speech stage (Care.speech) from which a Boki says lines instead of its name. tones = how a young Boki says its name, by feeling ({A} first syllable, {a} lower, {b} second syllable, {F} full name, {f} lower, {U} upper; KinSpeak.fill). sounds = noises a tone may use besides the name. alias = old trigger names that share another's lines. triggers: feel (a tone), word (the one word a stage-1 Boki adds), acts (what it does), lines._ (anyone) and lines.<element> (extra lines for a Boki of that element, the species' type).

## boki_quirks (`content/rules/boki_quirks.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| _doc | Species field-note details (Bokidex quirks-v1, owner 11-09). Keys are Bokidex ids: a game species' display name in lower case (BokiQuirks.key). 'quirk' and 'sexNote' are copied verbatim from bokidex/work/quirks-v1.json; the sections after them make a few of those notes real on the farm. |
| quirk | {"vespyx": "Hunts at dusk and buries spare prey in shallow scrapes, then forgets half of them.", "vespox": "Wipes its sting on bark every dawn; the scratched trees mark its patrol route.", "glaivyx": "Sleeps standing with the scythe tail raised; nothing wild roosts within a stone's throw.", "prismander": "Keep it by a window: its crystal frills grow faster in direct sunlight.", "glassolotl": "Chirps whenever a rainbow shows, often minutes before anyone else spots it.", "chandelotl": "Its gill crown dims when it sulks and blazes after a bite of sugar cane.", "mycroll": "Rolls through compost after rain; a happy one leaves glowing footprints at night.", "sporcupine": "Drops a few quills each wet morning; dried, they season stews with a smoky taste.", "amanitusk": "Scratches red warning rings into bark around its ground; farm Boki stay outside them.", "gravadillo": "Sleeps upside down on the barn ceiling, held there by its own pull.", "mothlet": "Falls asleep leaning on lanterns and wakes dusted in moth powder.", "lunowl": "Hunts only on clear nights; on cloudy ones it dozes and eats from your hand.", "eclipsowl": "Casts a dim ring of shade wherever it perches; crops beneath grow slowly.", "echolop": "Thumps a hind foot twice before anyone else hears a visitor coming.", "howlop": "Its night howl carries for miles; neighbouring farms treat it as a storm warning.", "rampartoad": "Will not move until it has sat at least an hour; shift it and it croaks.", "zipling": "Zips itself into any pocket you leave open and naps there.", "zippelith": "Leaves a thin seam across the field where it dives; follow it to its stash.", "seamwyrm": "Surfaces at midnight, always at the exact spot it dived three days earlier.", "anchorbill": "Hoards anything iron and drops it from height just to hear it ring.", "bellowlet": "Squeaks its chest in time with your footsteps when it wants carrying.", "bellowary": "Needs a hard run every morning or the bellows wheeze all day.", "furnacowary": "Eats charcoal by the sack; its chest glow tells you when it is hungry.", "wickapi": "Its single wick will not light while it is afraid; a calm one burns all night.", "snuffapi": "Lights one extra candle for each person it trusts; most never earn a second.", "chandelapi": "Only a fully bonded rider is allowed to snuff its candles by hand.", "coolatee": "Follows anyone carrying fresh fish and keeps it cold for them.", "frigatee": "Refuses to open its drawers in rain; loot stays shut until it dries.", "glaciatee": "Hums a different note for each drawer; keepers learn which note holds what.", "gongibbon": "Rings its own belly at sunrise; nobody on the farm sleeps late.", "gongrowl": "Each dent in its gong crest is a fight it remembers; it will not let you polish them.", "kayak": "Paddles across puddles on its back for fun and refuses to come out.", "prowyak": "Clears a path to your door after every snowfall without being asked.", "dreadnoyak": "Breathes frost on hot days to cool itself; stand downwind for relief.", "glintmole": "Pops up a minute before a tremor; other farm Boki learn to follow it out.", "geodemole": "Sorts dug-up stones by colour into little piles outside its burrow.", "druzemole": "Grows a new amethyst spike every full moon; the old ones can be traded.", "gloamshell": "Lanterns burn dimmer wherever it crawls; keep it out of the barn at night.", "glomwort": "Creeps toward spilled food overnight; sweep up or wake to a yellow net.", "effigeetle": "Will not fly in rain; raindrops on its marble face make it sneeze.", "crofthorn": "Herbs planted on its back grow twice as fast as those in the ground.", "skidlet": "Only stays upright on ice; on grass it topples and peeps for help.", "skateron": "Stands motionless at a pond edge for hours, then strikes exactly once.", "lanceron": "Its blade feathers hum in wind; a high whine means a gale tonight.", "ermink": "Dips its tail in any ink or mud and scribbles on your walls.", "flarmink": "Draws warm strokes on cold mornings; frost melts wherever it writes.", "rippmink": "Paints wave lines on the shore that show how high the next tide reaches.", "blossmink": "Petals it paints bloom real by morning if left on good soil.", "voltmink": "Its strokes crackle; on dry days its fur stands on end and shocks you.", "rimink": "Paints frost lace on windows at dawn, never the same pattern twice.", "umbrink": "Its ink never dries; whatever it marks stays smudged for days.", "lunink": "Only paints under moonlight; by day the silver fades to nothing.", "prismink": "Each stroke splits into a rainbow when the sun hits it.", "wyrmink": "Coils through the air leaving a trailing ink line that fades in seconds.", "kestrike": "Hovers over the same fence post before every storm; ## class_unlock (`content/rules/class_unlock.json`)

Hunter unlocks and mastery (docs/decisions/0005). A new save picks one of `starters` (Lace, Kael or Vex) on the first-Relic screen, wears it at the first portal and plays the tutorial as it. After its first finished expedition the player picks one of `second_picks` as the second Relic (the one already taken is not offered); a starter not taken and not in `second_picks` opens at that same moment. Every other Hunter opens through its own challenge in `unlock`, counted across all your expeditions whoever you play; a challenge with `after` also waits until that many Hunters are open. A done challenge never opens a Hunter by itself: the player holds the button on the Hunters screen for `hold_s` seconds. `mastery` lists each Hunter's goals, counted only in expeditions played as that Hunter; each one done is a mastery level and a cosmetic reward. Rewards are cosmetic only (`reward_kinds`). Ids are Hunter ids, never display names. Every number is a placeholder until the owner tunes it.

## dash_feel (`content/rules/dash_feel.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| doc | Dash feel (Shift) on top of each kit's own numbers in content/archetypes. dist: multiplier on distance. time: multiplier on duration (speed = dist / time). Parity first (DECISIONS 2026-11-07): a kit whose dash numbers are the source's measured dash runs them as-is (the default, 1.0 / 1.0): Vex, Hem, Cinder, Pip, Bjorn and Sable. Owner, Nov 2: dashes were too fast and too far in general, Sparkle's (Ryzz, mage) should go further. That rule stays only on the kits whose dash has no source number: Zedran's Rampage (owner 113.8), Grimble's Barge (owner 23:40) and Tarek's Rock Hop (owner item 111) at x0.85 distance, x1.15 time; Ryzz's Wirerun lane is the owner's own (item 70), so only its time is scaled. Claire's Skate and Ostra's Lantern Trade never pass through it. The felt table is asserted in --move-feel-check (docs/KIT_PARITY.md gap 4). Gil runs his own numbers (x1). curve (optional): the hero's measured ground dash speed over the dash, [u, k] knots, u = share of the dash's time, k = speed against the dash's mean (mean 1, so the distance holds), fitted to the hero-ref frame tracks (docs/SUPERVIVE_FEEL.md, docs/decisions/0025); the dash then hands over through HunterMove.dash_exit. Heroes with no curve dash at a constant speed. |
| default | {"dist": 1.0, "time": 1.0} |
| juggernaut | {"dist": 0.85, "time": 1.15, "curve": [[0, 0.12], [0.27, 1.73], [0.29, 1.73], [1, 0.28]]} |
| dredge | {"dist": 0.85, "time": 1.15} |
| dolm | {"dist": 0.85, "time": 1.15} |
| mage | {"dist": 1.0, "time": 1.15} |
| gunslinger | {"dist": 1.0, "time": 1.0, "curve": [[0, 0.01], [0.09, 1.81], [0.13, 1.81], [1, 0.13]]} |
| archer | {"dist": 1.0, "time": 1.0, "curve": [[0, 0.17], [0.44, 1.86], [1, 0.12]]} |

## evolve (`content/rules/evolve.json`)

Evolution (scripts/core/evo.gd). Each entry is a Boki species id and what it evolves into. 'level': the level it evolves at (a level-up at or past it). 'into': the options; 'path' picks a branch by the Boki's leading affinity (fierce/steadfast/curious/swift), 'item' needs that Ink used on it (any level), 'trade' needs it traded to another player. Ids that have no data yet are the owner's roster names in lower case. A Boki never evolves into a species without data and a model (art/kin/<id>/<id>.glb and a BokiRig FRAME row); it waits, and evolves once the art exists.

## farm_build (`content/rules/farm_build.json`)

The farm building pass (docs/decisions/0004-farm-building.md). Farm level is points from play; items unlock by farm level or a milestone; new buildings are construction sites that you hammer (hold interact) and your Boki help build; the materials are spent a quarter at a time as the work goes; buildings upgrade L1 to L3. Units: gems and materials are counts, labour is work swings (one hammer beat of yours is 0.8 s, one swing of a Boki is about 3 s at building skill 1).

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| base_mode | False |
| base_mode_doc | GARDEN.md section 8: true shrinks the farm to the Boki base. Build mode shows only Buildings, Garden and Island; no axe, pickaxe or wild chopping; no work stations, wild or haul jobs (Boki knacks still run the plot, mend and incubator chores); no Exchange, Sell tab, tools or crop-chain goods at the market; meals lean a Boki by the food's type (content/rules/lean.json, Lean) instead of the four affinities. Nothing is deleted: false changes nothing, and saves are untouched either way. |
| points | {"extracts": 3.0, "bosses": 6.0, "caught": 2.0, "hatched": 2.0, "harvested": 0.25, "built": 2.0, "fb_built": 2.0} |
| points_doc | Farm points = sum(stat * weight). 'built' counts the lot buildings you built, 'fb_built' the buildings Boki finished on the farm. |

## farm_builder (`content/rules/farm_builder.json`)

Hob Brackenridge, the farm's builder (docs/decisions/0011-farm-builder-tutorial.md). He stands by the market stall (and works at the house while it goes up); walk up and press interact to talk face to face ('talk'). Blueprints with a level or milestone in farm_build.json unlock for real only once Hob has drawn them up, so a level-up or milestone makes a 'new blueprints' toast and a mark over his head. Everything with no entry there is on offer from the start.

## farm_tutorial (`content/rules/farm_tutorial.json`)

The guided farm tutorial (state: Save.d.tutorial.ft = {did, done, skipped}). Short, one prompt at a time, not skippable on a new save (owner, Nov 3 DECISIONS.md). Every owner-confirmable choice is under 'options' so it is a one-line change.

|---|---|
| options | {"tracker_replaces_day1": true, "player_swing": true, "crop_stage_s": 6, "end_gems": 30, "skippable": false, "house_cost_in": "farm_build.json build.house (wood and stone, spent as it goes up, and swings of labour)", "free_order": true, "free_tools": true, "market_gems": true} |
| options_doc | tracker_replaces_day1: the top-right card is the Goals tracker. player_swing: holding the interact key near a site hammers (hold it: a hammer beat every HunterTool.TOOLS.hammer.period seconds), so one Boki is enough. end_gems: the one reward at the end (the old +5 each and +30). free_order: after the house is down feed, crop and the rest can come in any order (meeting Hob comes first: he calls you over) (false: strictly in the listed order). skippable: shows a Skip button (the owner says the farm tutorial cannot be skipped on a new save). free_tools: a step with gives_tool hands that tool over (the axe, the pickaxe); the Market still sells them later. market_gems: the buy step tops the gems up to one seed's price so nobody gets stuck. |

## garden_daily (`content/rules/garden_daily.json`)

The garden's daily hooks (scripts/home/garden_wishes.gd, scripts/home/garden_away.gd; briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md section 5, ranks 1 and 3). Each garden day three Boki wish for something (a need back up); granting one is a gift, nothing is ever taken for missing a day. Coming back after time away brings small gifts. Nothing here lowers a need or a stat.

## garden_items (`content/rules/garden_items.json`)

Shaping items (scripts/core/garden_items.gd; design briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md section 1). They live in the garden bag (Save.d items), are fed from a Boki's feed menu, and always show their exact effect (no 'Effect: ?' rule). Effects: stat = +n to one Care.STATS stat up to its cap; xp = +n xp (levels and forms follow); token = a worn path token for the aff (rec.path, at most max_tokens, take_off returns it to the bag); stay = worn Stayleaf (rec.stay); rinse = clear rec.lean; loose = up to n points out of the Boki's highest stat into rec.loose; stat_all = +n to all four stats (up to the level cap); sweet = the picked type among types jumps to share of Evo.LEAN_FULL and holds (rec.hold, hold_days garden days, no fade from other meals); trait = a trait moves by (signed), counted in base_drift week_cap (rec.drift.moved); twin = shared by two Boki: trait by on each and bond between them. sources are where the item comes from; this file does not drop them. Nest items (scripts/core/nest_items.gd) are placed in the Nesting Nook with a pair and used up when the egg is laid: nest gifts = n more inborn gifts from the parents per Thread (at most max Threads); species = the baby is the species of the parent wearing it; habit = the baby takes that parent's habit and strongest trait exactly. down = trust +trust and a memory line (one drops at every hatch).

## garden_prizes (`content/rules/garden_prizes.json`)

Garden minigame prizes and weekly cups (scripts/home/garden_prizes.gd; briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md section 4.4). Each game has a weighted prize table (one roll for the backed Boki's win), a guaranteed first-win-of-the-day item, and a cup of three wins in a row against stronger rivals (cup.rounds). Winning the last round (Crown) gives the game's Cup Ribbon to the winning Boki (rec.ribbons) and the cup prize; one Crown per game per week per Boki. Table entries: kind item = a shaping item id in garden_items.json (banked in Save.d items), kind snack = a Data.CROPS food (banked in Save.d crops).

Trust from care at the base (Care.trust_up). Petting, its habit food and winning together each raise trust by a named amount, shown to the player as one plain line. Trust stays 0 to 100 and nothing here lowers it. A habit (rec.habit.food) is picked when a Boki hatches, from its element (the species theme).

## garden_visitor (`content/rules/garden_visitor.json`)

Wild visitors (briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md section 5 rank 6; scripts/home/garden_visitor.gd). While you are in a zone, every check_s seconds of farm time and with no visitor and none due to wait, a wild Boki may wander in: one of the common species that has a rigged model, whose theme is in the zone's group, when the zone has a toy it likes (toys.json likes) and at least residents of the group living there. It stays one garden day (care.json care_day_s), plays your games as one more Boki, and eats only what you hand it. feeds meals of its favourite make it leave an egg (or, with room in the zone, ask to stay as a new Boki). Save.d visitor = {rec, zone, t, fed, notes, next}, a lazy key with no save bump.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| check_s | 60 |
| check_s_doc | Seconds of farm time between looks at whether a visitor comes. |
| chance | 0.3 |
| chance_doc | Chance a look brings a visitor when the zone suits one: about one every three minutes in a zone that does. |
| residents | 2 |
| residents_doc | Residents of the visitor's type group a zone needs. |
| feeds | 3 |
| feeds_doc | Favourite meals it takes before it leaves an egg or asks to stay. |
| gap_s | 300 |
| gap_s_doc | Seconds after one leaves before the next may come (one garden day). |
| groups | {"bramblebank": ["bloom", "swarm", "spore"], "glasswater": ["prism", "frost"], "cinderstep": ["ember", "stone", "titan", "gravity"], "hushwood": ["shadow", "lunar", "venom"], "ridge": ["storm", "tempest", "echo"]} |
| groups_doc | Species themes (content/kin_v2 theme) that live in each zone, from the types in garden_zones.json and the toy likes in toys.json. |

## garden_zones (`content/rules/garden_zones.json`)

The garden's hub and zones (briefs/design/GARDEN.md 10; scripts/home/garden_zones.gd, docs/decisions/0022-garden-zones.md). Save.d zones = {id: {open}}, rec zone = the Boki's home zone. zones: name, colour (its stone's glow and card), types (lean.json types; the 18 split five ways), loves (two favoured types and a nature, see affinity), trait (Care trait it matches), game (what its card says is played there) and wayseed_from (where the card says the Wayseed comes from). A zone with a build has its own island (scripts/home/zone_layout.gd, zone_dress.gd): theme (a HomeLayout.THEMES id), seed and sk (the fs island), deco [id, tile x, tile z, quarter turns], shallow [x0, z0, x1, z1] tiles of the channel (only Glasswater has one), clear [x0, z0, x1, z1] tiles kept free of the wild trees and rocks (they are the costliest draws; the scatter dresses the zone instead), scatter (seed, a count per kind: crystal, reed, pebble, terrace, crack; shore = tiles the crystals and reeds crowd the channel).

## glint_fishing (`content/rules/glint_fishing.json`)

Glint Fishing (briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md 4.2 game 4; scripts/home/glint_fishing.gd). Solo with your partner on a rock in a zone that has a spot. Five casts: hold interact to swing the cast out and back, release on a glint, wait, press when your Boki's ears go up, then hold and release to keep the line's tension in the band until the glint is landed. Units: seconds, metres, tension 0-1, stats 0-100 points, joy and trust 0-100.

|---|---|

## mantle_look (`content/rules/mantle_look.json`)

The Relic look (docs/decisions/0011-mantle-look.md). In a match a Relic wearer looks like the class's original Hunter (`wardens`: gender, folk, face, hair, palette; the class's gear and silhouette come from the archetype), nudged by the player's own person (Save look, PlayerLook). Each slider (0..1, 0.5 = neutral) moves its model factor by at most `sliders.<key>.clamp` either way (a Hunter's own `clamp` block overrides it); at home the player is their own person, with `own_k` times that range and their own colours. Each colour pick pulls the Hunter's colour `pull` of the way in HSV, never more than `hue` / `sat` / `val` (a Warden's `tint` block overrides it), so signature colours stay. Hitboxes never read any of this. `presets` set the face sliders as a starting point. Gender is the base character's (OWNER_REVIEW item 39; 'robot' builds on the male body).

## mask_moment (`content/rules/mask_moment.json`)

Putting on a Relic (MaskBeat, scripts/ui/mask_beat.gd): build-up, the Relic rising to the face, a cut to black and silence, flashes of the fallen Hunter with a whisper, the snap back with an impact and a ripple of light, a pose, the name and title, and a sting. Times in seconds. 'full' is the first Mask (and every first time); 'short' is a later Mask on the farm. After the first one the player can skip.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| full | {"build_s": 1.2, "rise_s": 1.4, "black_s": 0.7, "memory_s": [0.3, 0.28, 0.36], "reveal_s": 1.6, "push_in": 0.7} |
| short | {"build_s": 0.5, "rise_s": 0.8, "black_s": 0.45, "memory_s": [0.38], "reveal_s": 1.5, "push_in": 0.6} |
| times_doc | build_s: the world quiets, the camera eases in, swell and heartbeat. rise_s: the Relic lifts to the face in slow motion while a ghostly porcelain face flickers over yours. black_s: the hard silence after contact. memory_s: one entry per memory frame of the fallen Hunter (their painted art). reveal_s: the snap back to the end (pose, name and title, sting). push_in: how far the camera eases in (0..1 of the way to the face). |
| music_duck_db | -30 |
| heart_gaps_s | [0.62, 0.5, 0.4, 0.32] |
| punch_fov | 5 |

Feed it, or it feeds on you.", "archer": "Every mask I sewed, I will cut loose.", "bulwark": "Hold on. The shore is close.", "mage": "One day I give the storm back.", "ashwick": "Bottled Blight. Drink up.", "dredge": "Come down where it's quiet.", "tender": "Stay close to the light.", "rimewright": "Skate. Don't look down at the ice.", "dolm": "Stone remembers what eyes forget.", "ostra": "Go on, laugh. I'll keep it.", "thief": "I only meant to take a look.", "gil": "Ooh, what does this one do?"} |

## mode_boki (`content/rules/mode_boki.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|

## show_ring (`content/rules/show_ring.json`)

Show Ring, a judged show on a small stage near the Training post (briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md 4.2 game 3, scripts/home/show_ring.gd). Only with farm_build.json base_mode on. Two rested Boki show: the one you back and a rival. Three rounds of up to 10 points each: Look (how it has been raised), Trick (three timed presses, the trick picked by its best stat) and Bond (it walks to you past a snack, a toy and the rival; you call as it passes each). Three judges post a taste for the week; each judge whose taste the Boki fits adds taste_bonus. Every score is worked out from the records and the presses only, so the same Boki and presses always score the same. Units: seconds, points, needs and trust 0-100, traits 0-1.

|---|---|

| doc | The ONE movement and feel tuning file (owner 11-08), read by scripts/core/locomotion.gd (Loco) for the farm avatar and every match hunter alike. Live: with the movement readout open (F7, or Settings > Controls), saving this file re-reads it within poll_s. Units: m, s, m/s, m/s^2; drags are 1/s (the share of the excess lost per second, exponential). air: accel = how hard WASD pushes in the air; counter = multiplier on accel for the part of your speed going against the keys (a backward drift turns forward in ~0.1 s); side = multiplier for the part going across the keys (bends the arc); drag = how fast speed above your run cap (dash, knock, launch) bleeds in the air; idle_drag = what a jump with no keys loses per second. glide (the pull toward where you steer is [game data], HunterMove.glide_accel): turn / turn_fast = deg/s at cruise and the share kept at the max; brake / brake_deg = pulling back past this angle brakes this hard; drag = how fast speed above cruise bleeds with no keys (back to cruise in ~1.5 s), drag_steer = the same while steering; coast = m/s^2 a let-go under cruise slows; catch = m/s^2 the canopy eases a fall to its sink rate (absorbed, never turned into speed; ours: the source clamps the fall the step the glider opens, HunterMove.glide_start_vy, and its fastest-fall half is locked); max = the fastest a glide carries. glide_carry: per hunter, speed above this carried from Shift into a glide bleeds at carry_drag (on top of drag), so a dash never turns into a long sprint. dash.jump_keep: the share of a ground dash's speed a jump out of it keeps (the rest is air drag's, Loco.air_step; 1 = all of it, a long dash-jump). dash_speed: per hunter, a dash's speed scale (its time stretches so the distance stays); the shape of a dash (ease in, peak, skid) is the hunter's source curve in content/rules/dash_feel.json. |
| poll_s | 0.5 |

## unstable_mix (`content/rules/unstable_mix.json`)

When two Boki are paired in the Nesting Nook the pair is an unstable mix if their elements clash (a pair in clashes) or their tempers oppose (bravery or temper at least trait_gap apart, 0 to 1). The baby then hatches with joy at hatch_joy (0 to 100) and the 'Needs extra care' tag, which clears after care_s seconds spent doing at least fine_condition (0 to 100 Care.condition). A story, never a loss. types maps each game type id to its standard name (GAME_RULES_NOV8, 18 types).

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| hatch_joy | 35 |
| care_s | 86400 |
| fine_condition | 50 |
| trait_gap | 0.5 |
| traits | {"temper": ["hot-headed", "mellow"], "bravery": ["bold", "timid"]} |
| types | {"ember": "Fire", "tide": "Water", "bloom": "Grass", "storm": "Electric", "frost": "Ice", "venom": "Poison", "swarm": "Bug", "stone": "Rock", "tempest": "Flying", "wild": "Normal", "titan": "Steel", "wyrm": "Dragon", "shadow": "Dark", "lunar": "Fairy", "prism": "Crystal", "spore": "Spore", "echo": "Sound", "gravity": "Psychic"} |

## wade (`content/rules/wade.json`)

Boki wading (GARDEN.md section 4, scripts/home/boki_wade.gd; only while farm_build.json base_mode is on). A Boki in pond or stream water walks at wade_speed (shallow edge) or deep_speed (the middle) of its dry speed, leaves a ripple every ripple_secs and a splash going in, and shakes off coming out. Water, Ice and Crystal leans paddle: with linger_chance a free roaming one stays linger_secs in the water playing (the splash clip) and gains joy_per_sec. Fire leans hurry out: at out_speed to the nearest dry ground, which takes under 2 s. Everyone else wades through. Units: multipliers of walk speed, seconds, joy points a second.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| wade_speed | 0.6 |
| deep_speed | 0.45 |
| ripple_secs | 0.6 |
| shake_secs | 0.6 |
| paddle | ["water", "ice", "prism", "frost", "crystal"] |
| paddle_doc | Lean or species-theme keys (HomeToys.lean_of) that paddle: the Water, Ice and Crystal types (themes prism and frost today). |
| fire | ["fire", "ember"] |
| fire_doc | Lean or species-theme keys that step out fast: the Fire type (theme ember today). |
| out_speed | 1.5 |
| out_reach | 8 |
| out_reach_doc | m: how far a Fire Boki looks for dry ground to step out to. |
| linger_chance | 0.6 |
| linger_secs | [4.0, 8.0] |
| joy_per_sec | 0.8 |

## warden_look (`content/rules/warden_look.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| doc | A Warden 3D model's own shading over the shared painted look (WardenGlb.look), keyed by the model's art name (art/wardens/<art>/<art>.glb; a design variant has its own key). painted: hero_toon.gdshader parameters on all of its surfaces, set after WardenGlb.PAINTED. slots: the same per toon slot (skin, hair, cloth, leather, metal, eyes, glow), after painted. Colours are [r, g, b]. A model without an entry keeps the shared look. Useful keys: rim_far and rim_far_color (a rim in the Hunter's signature colour at the match camera), top_light (surfaces facing up lift), fres and fres_tint (the coloured rim; 1 = lightened own colour), far_lift (brighter and richer at the match camera), shade and shadow_tint (the shadow floor and its tint), sheen, glow (emission x the painted colour), light_neutral_warm (how much of the hue it takes out of warm lights; WardenGlb.PAINTED 0.8 so the amber sun leaves no red cast, 1 for none at all). halos: glow discs of a constant size on screen on the model's anchors (a lens a pixel wide at the match camera): anchor, color, strength, px (radius on screen), near and far (m: none this close, full from there; close-ups keep the lens itself). albedo: a colour multiplier on the slot's atlas, applied on top of the player's colour pick (it never replaces the pick). Match zoom (the shared far_* look, WardenGlb.PAINTED; set these per model only to tune it): far_fres (the pale fresnel's share left at the match camera, 0.35), far_spec (gloss, sheen and the lights' rims there, 0), far_clamp (stray texels pulled to their coarser mip, 0.8), far_rim_soft (1: rim_far is a broad saturated band in rim_far_color; keep rim_far 0.25-0.35), far_glow (whatever glows a step brighter there, 0.6). no_ink: material tags or slots drawn without the ink shell (e.g. ["gum", "crossbow"]). ink: the model's own ink shell, far_thin (0.8), far_cut (0.55: gone from ~13.5 m; 0 keeps it), color. glow_shell: the glow slot's halo at the match camera (glow_px 1.4 screen px, glow_k 1.3, glow_near 7, glow_far 14 m, glow_col; {"glow_px": 0} for none). A card slot's far keys (shaders/warden_card.gdshader, under slots.card): far_sheen 0, far_edge 1, far_alpha 1.35. the same per toon slot (skin, hair, cloth, leather, metal, brass, eyes, glow), after painted; a "<slot>-<tag>" key (hair-braid: the woven braids) after its slot. paint_glow, paint_glow_color and paint_glow_width: texels of that painted colour glow (a skin's tattoos at night). weapon_scale: a size multiplier on the held .glb weapon; weapon_offset: [x, y, z] metres that move it in the Gun's space (seats the grip in the hand: Lace's bow). |

## warden_stance (`content/rules/warden_stance.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| doc | Each Warden's signature stance on the shared rig (scripts/match/warden_stance.gd), keyed by archetype id. gait: how the body stands and moves over its class (HunterAnim.STANCE keys: knee, width, lean, bounce, arm, elbow, cadence, stride, fidgets). pose: offsets on the rig's bones, full in idle and blended into run, aim and abilities at the blend weights below. spine: forward lean (rad, + forward). tilt: the shoulders drop toward the weight leg (rad). twist: the shoulders turn (rad, + left). hip: the hips shift over the weight leg (m). lift: the body up (m, + up). back: the hips back (m). knee: extra bend in both knees (rad). spread: the legs wider apart (rad). free_leg: the free leg's hip (+ forward) and knee bend (rad). head: pitch (+ chin up), yaw (+ left), roll (+ toward the left shoulder) (rad). arm_l: the free left hand's place from its rest (m, model space: x right, y up, z back). carry: the weapon's idle place under Aim, pos (m) and rot (pitch, yaw, roll, rad), free_l 1 to let the left hand off it (free_r 1: the right, for a weapon carried in the left hand); it blends to the aim pose the moment the Hunter fires. leg: the weight leg (l or r). idle: breath (rate, rad/s), breath_amp (x the breathing), shift (s on the weight leg before a short shift to the other), fidget (every and dur in s; body, head, hip and gun offsets at the fidget's peak, wave times over). |

## weapon_path (`content/rules/weapon_path.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| _doc | The fixed weapon path (scripts/match/weapon_path.gd): on every even level (2, 4, 6, 8, 10) a hunter's signature weapon takes the next step on its hero's path, with no choice to make. Each step is a plain weapon upgrade id from Data.PERKS (WeaponUps: hotload = damage, deepmag = magazine (only Vex: no other hero weapon has ammo), quickfeed = fire rate, longreach = range). One entry per hero in Arch.ORDER. Brands are not on the path: they come from perk orbs. If an orb already maxed a step, the next open plain upgrade is taken instead. default is for a hunter with no hero. |
| default | ["hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed"] |
| paths | {"thief": ["hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed"], "gil": ["quickfeed", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach"], "archer": ["hotload", "longreach", "quickfeed", "hotload", "longreach"], "mage": ["hotload", "hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach", "hotload"], "gunslinger": ["quickfeed", "hotload", "deepmag", "hotload", "longreach"], "juggernaut": ["hotload", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed", "hotload"], "bulwark": ["hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed"], "dredge": ["hotload", "hotload", "hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach"], "ashwick": ["hotload", "longreach", "hotload", "hotload", "quickfeed"], "tender": ["quickfeed", "hotload", "hotload", "longreach", "hotload"], "rimewright": ["hotload", "longreach", "quickfeed", "hotload", "longreach"], "dolm": ["hotload", "quickfeed", "hotload", "longreach", "quickfeed"], "ostra": ["hotload", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed", "hotload"]} |

## wisp_looks (`content/rules/wisp_looks.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| _doc | Wisp looks (docs/decisions/0019-downed-wisp.md): what a downed Hunter turns into. Add a look = add an entry under 'looks'; any key left out comes from 'default'. A look is chosen by its id in Save.d['look']['wisp']. Every look keeps the round outline (round = Hunter, critter = Boki). Colours: 'team' (the hunter's side colour, SideColor: you, ally, foe) or a hex string. core.rim_width is the fraction of the radius in the rim colour. body: radius and squash of the round body, head the radius of the head on top. hover is the body centre's height; drag how far the body trails behind the hunter, settle the seconds it takes to catch up (heavy), lean the tilt in radians at full drag. Times in seconds, sizes in metres, sfx names from Sfx.NAMES, hum.db the hum's level. |
| default | default |
| looks | {"default": {"name": "Wisp", "desc": "A round soul-light in your team's colour with a white heart, slow and heavy.", "core": {"rim": "team", "color": "ffffff", "rim_width": 0.3, "glow": 1.3}, "body": {"radius": 0.3, "squash": 0.85, "head": 0.16}, "hover": 0.4, "bob": 0.04, "bob_hz": 0.45, "drag": 0.45, "settle": 0.5, "lean": 0.35, "hum": {"sfx": "wisp_hum", "db": -14.0}, "pop_in": {"time": 0.25, "ring": 1.4, "burst": 14, "sfx": "scan_pop"}, "pop_out": {"time": 0.3, "ring": 1.8, "burst": 18, "sfx": "revive", "hero_from": 0.6, "squash": 0.25}, "snuff": {"burst": 24, "sfx": "hit"}}} |

## Combos

One fighter sets a foe up with a status, the partner pays it off (`content/combos/`).

| Combo | Shows | Set up by | With | Paid off by | Window | Bonus | Bond |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Combo | COMBO | your Boki | stun, root | you | 2.5s | +35% | +5% of a meter |
| Kindling | FLARE | anyone | burn | your Boki's ability | 3s | +25% | +3% of a meter |
| Pounce | POUNCE | you | stun, slow | your Boki | 2.5s | +60% | +4% of a meter |
